title.note: Game title, glossary keep: no official Chinese title given, so it stays English.

hud.reel.note: 收線 = reel the line in; same verb as the pass name 自動收線.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form, as the context suggests; reads right for 0, 1 and any count.

catch.success.note: Han params joined with no space or classifier (你釣到了稀有黃金鯉魚！), like the guide's egg.hatched pattern; no agreement problems in Chinese.

catch.escaped.note: Chinese needs a subject, so 'It' becomes the generic 魚; 溜走 = slipped away. Ellipsis written as …… per the guide.

catch.new_record.note: kg written 公斤, the everyday Taiwan unit word; {weight} with a decimal point (12.4) reads correctly.

fish.golden_carp.note: 黃金鯉 is a known golden carp/koi name in Taiwan; 魚 added so the base form reads as a fish when inserted into catch.success.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Glossary translate: 燈籠 (lantern) keeps the glowing-lantern idea and the echo of Lantern Lake; 鰻 = eel.

rarity.mythic.note: Guide's rarity set: 神話 ranks above 傳說 (Legendary).

shop.equip.blind_remark: the same word is also the noun "equipment"; on a button it reads as "Equip"

pass.lucky_bait.text: 幸運魚餌讓你釣到稀有魚的機率加倍！

sell.done.text: 賣出 {count} 條魚，賺到 {coins} 金幣！
sell.done.note: 條 is the classifier for fish; no plurals in Chinese, so count and coins read right at 1. 賺到 (earned) is the natural verb for selling for coins.

ascend.button.note: Prestige reset for a permanent bonus: 晉升 (advance a rank) avoids 轉生, which the guide reserves for Rebirth, and avoids 飛升 (cultivation/spiritual ascension) and climbing words. Worth a native check.
ascend.button.blind_remark: the word means a promotion in rank, as at work or in the military; nothing suggests starting over

ascend.confirm.text: 要現在晉升嗎？你會從頭開始，但之後釣到稀有魚的機率會提高 {bonus}%。
ascend.confirm.note: 'catch rare fish {bonus}% more often' rendered as the chance of catching rare fish rising by {bonus}%; 之後 (from then on) carries the future sense without adding 'permanent', which the source does not say.

weather.storm.text: 暴風雨要來了！稀有魚紛紛上鉤！
weather.storm.note: 'are biting' = 紛紛上鉤 (taking the hook one after another); second sentence takes ！ for the excited banner tone.
weather.storm.blind_remark: says the storm is still coming, not that it is here now

quest.catch_n.text: 在月光灣釣到 {n} 條魚
quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay translated per glossary as 月光灣; 條 is the fish classifier, correct for n = 1.

friends.boost.text: 和好友一起釣魚，幸運值 +{percent}%
friends.boost.note: Stat-line form; luck as the stat 幸運值 (shares 幸運 with 幸運魚餌). '+' and % kept, no space before %.

trade.sent.text: 已向 {player} 送出交易請求

trade.accept.note: 'your trade' = your trade request, per context; no pronoun refers to {player}.

codes.redeemed.text: 兌換成功！好好享受你的獎勵吧！
codes.redeemed.note: 'Code redeemed' rendered as 兌換成功 (redeemed successfully), the usual Chinese UI wording; friendly 吧 instead of a stiff 請.

afk.kicked.text: 你閒置太久，已停止釣魚。
afk.kicked.note: 閒置 (idle) matches Roblox's own zh-tw idle text; no mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

settings.sfx.note: 音效 is the standard Taiwan settings term. Lint flags 音 as Simplified-only, a false positive: 音 is identical in both scripts and sits in both SIMPLIFIED_ONLY and TRADITIONAL_ONLY in scripts/i18n.py (so do 盾 and 魂); fix the lint sets, not this text.

event.ends.note: Developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters, which looks foreign to Taiwan players; localized 2 天 4 小時 would read better (then the space before 後 should go). Translated as is per the guide.

daily.streak.text: 連續登入第 {day} 天！明天再來領更多獎勵吧！
daily.streak.note: 'Day {day} streak' = logged in {day} days in a row (連續登入第 N 天), fine for day 1; 'for more' made explicit as 更多獎勵 (more rewards).

tip.night.text: 小提示：有些魚只有晚上才會上鉤。
tip.night.note: 小提示 is the friendly tip label; 'bite' = 上鉤, same word as weather.storm.

group.join.text: 加入群組，免費領取 50 個魚餌！
group.join.note: 群組 is Roblox's zh-tw word for groups; 個 classifier added for the count of bait.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest' = heaviest per context, so 最重 (heaviest) rather than 最大; 漁獲 = a catch (noun).
